reviews.title: Perfect, no regrets.
reviews.comment: Great! If you’re looking for some good looking RAM I 100% recommend. If you are looking for straight functionality you might want to look at some alternatives but this is 100% perfect for my build.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: Good build quality
reviews.comment: It’s a quit solid DDR5 memory with good thermal dissipation plate armor. The default RGB pattern is good. Don’t use the iCUE one.
reviews.author: JinyueZ

reviews.title: BEAST OF A RAM
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] The ram works fantastic, love how you can change some aesthetics to it as well. I will say at the moment of writing the review the ram is super expensive, however if the prices do drop back down to msrp it is 100% worth the value.
